LT.voiceSummary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has secured a significant order from Noida Metro Rail Corporation Ltd for the design and construction of the Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension Project. The Heavy Civil Infrastructure business vertical will handle part design and construction of a 15.1 km elevated viaduct extending from Botanical Garden to Noida Sector-142, and from Depot Station to Boraki. The scope includes building 10 elevated metro stations with architectural finishes. The project is scheduled for completion within 36 months. The order is classified as significant, indicating a value between 1,000 to 2,500 crore rupees. This announcement was issued on November 9, 2026.

MPHASIS.attchmntText: MphasiS Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
MPHASIS.voiceSummary: Mphasis Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on November 6, 2026, pursuant to SEBI Regulation 30. The company reported net new total contract value of $466 million for the quarter. CEO Nitin Rakesh stated the firm achieved its strongest sequential growth in three years and raised its annual growth guidance. AI-led deals now constitute 71% of the pipeline. Direct business revenue grew 3.5% sequentially and 11.3% year-over-year in constant currency. The Americas remained the primary growth engine. EBIT margin remained flat. Earnings per share increased 14.6% sequentially to INR 29.4. Operating cash flow was USD 34 million. Days sales outstanding stood at 105 days. The transcript is available on the company website.

NATIONALUM.attchmntText: National Aluminium Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
NATIONALUM.voiceSummary: National Aluminium Company Limited filed the transcript of its Earnings Conference Call held on 03.11.2026 with BSE and NSE. The call discussed business outlook post declaration of Unaudited Financial Results for the 2nd Quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The company reported all-time high H1 revenue of INR11,143 crores, EBITDA of INR5,539 crores, PBT of INR5,160 crores, and PAT of INR3,837 crores. H1 net profit increased by 54% year-on-year. Q2 net profit was Rs.1,835 crores, up 28% year-on-year. Chairman Brijendra Pratap Singh stated the 5th Stream refinery is targeting production start in late December or early January. The brownfield smelter expansion at Angul involves an investment of INR17,000 to INR18,000 crores, with board approval expected in February. The company confirmed no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information was shared during the call.

GLAND.attchmntText: Gland Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Xiao Le as the Chief Investment Officer for Gland Pharma International Pte. Ltd (Wholly- owned subsidiary of Gland Pharma Limited), effective November 09, 2026
GLAND.voiceSummary: Gland Pharma Limited has appointed Mr. Xiao Le as the Chief Investment Officer of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Gland Pharma International Pte. Ltd, effective November 09, 2026. Mr. Xiao Le will report to the CEO of Gland Singapore and is responsible for exploring investment opportunities and improving M&A capability in the United States of America, China, Singapore, and other countries. He holds over 15 years of experience in investment and asset management within medical devices, biopharma, and healthcare services. His background includes roles as Chief Financial Officer for MegaRobo Technologies, Director at CANbridge Pharmaceuticals, and Senior Director of M&A and Strategic Investments for Wuxi AppTec. Mr. Xiao Le holds a Bachelor’s degree in Bio-engineering from The Johns Hopkins University and a Master’s degree in Finance from The Massachusetts Institute of Technology. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

ASTERDM.attchmntText: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Reports of Audit Committee and Independent Directors of the Company certifying that the Company has compensated the eligible shareholders of Quality Care India Limited who were eligible for fractional shares of the Company pursuant to the Scheme'.
ASTERDM.voiceSummary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited submitted reports from its Audit Committee and Independent Directors certifying the distribution of net sale proceeds to shareholders entitled to fractional shares following the amalgamation with Quality Care India Limited. The scheme became effective on 1 July 2026. On 13 July 2026, the company allotted 35,35,51,410 equity shares to eligible shareholders. Consolidated fractional shares totaling 65 equity shares were sold on the National Stock Exchange of India on 8 October 2026 at an average price of 676.0669 per share. NUVAMA.voiceSummary: PAGAC Ecstasy Pte. Ltd., a promoter of Nuvama Wealth Management Limited, has created an encumbrance over 3,50,74,460 equity shares. Net asset value per share was INR 2,224 on a consolidated basis and INR 1,787 on a standalone basis. The company declared an interim dividend of INR 14.40 per share. SMLMAH.attchmntText: SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates for the month of October 2026
SMLMAH.voiceSummary: SML Mahindra Limited filed its production, sales, and export report for October 2026. For commercial vehicles, production was 1206 units in FY 2026 and 1369 units in FY 2027. Sales were 995 units in FY 2026 and 958 units in FY 2027. Exports were 64 units in FY 2026 and 107 units in FY 2027. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. on 9th November 2026. The company scrip code is 505192 and symbol is SMLMAH. The report was signed by Parvesh Madan, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

TTKPRESTIG.attchmntText: TTK Prestige Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
TTKPRESTIG.voiceSummary: TTK Prestige Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper advertisement of its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement appeared in Business Line, Economic Times, and Dinamalar on November 07, 2026. The company enclosed a copy of the advertisement for the exchange's records. The provided text also contains unrelated news reports on Hindalco Industries, GSPL Transmission, Gujarat Pipavav Port, and Gujarat Energy, which are not part of this specific corporate filing.

NORTHARC.attchmntText: Northern Arc Capital Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
NORTHARC.voiceSummary: Northern Arc Capital Limited has filed the transcript of the earnings conference call held on Tuesday, November 03, 2026. The call covered the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The transcript is accessible via the link Transcript_Q2_FY2026-27. The intimation was submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. It references an earlier intimation letter dated October 29, 2026. The document is also available on the company website at https://www.northernarc.com/financial-results. The filing was signed by Prakash Chandra Panda, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The submission was addressed to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.

SFL.attchmntText: Sheela Foam Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
SFL.voiceSummary: Sheela Foam Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 03, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue growth of 19% to INR1,045 crores for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Operating EBITDA stood at INR87 crores, while profit after tax reached INR46 crores, approximately five times the previous year. For the half-year, revenue grew 22% to INR2,077 crores with operating EBITDA at INR200 crores and PAT at INR109 crores. Management cited raw material price increases and a shift in festive demand as key market factors. The firm highlighted the acquisition of Furlenco as a subsidiary effective October 01, 2026, noting its revenue growth to INR229 crores in the first half. International operations in Australia and Spain also contributed to the financial performance.

TTML.attchmntText: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited has submitted their response.
TTML.voiceSummary: Tata Teleservices Maharashtra Limited responded to the National Stock Exchange regarding a clarification on a spurt in volume. The company stated it has always promptly intimated events and information required for disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The firm confirmed it will continue to disclose such information in the future as and when any such event or information occurs. The company further stated that at this stage there is nothing further to disclose. The communication was signed by Sweety Mamodia, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 9, 2026.

GOLDIAM.attchmntText: Goldiam International Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
GOLDIAM.voiceSummary: Goldiam International Limited published newspaper advertisements on November 9, 2026, regarding its Unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone total income from operations was 18,443.35 lakhs for the three months ended September 30, 2026, with a profit after tax of 2,542.84 lakhs. Consolidated total income from operations was 29,166.46 lakhs for the same period, with a net profit after tax of 4,939.88 lakhs. Rishi Laser Limited reported standalone revenue from operations of 5,438.29 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and a profit after tax of 114.36 lakhs. SBFC Finance Limited issued demand notices under the SARFAESI Act on October 14, 2026, to borrowers Anita Ravindra Shinde and Ravindra Taeram Shinde for an outstanding amount of 48,82,971 rupees, and to Roshan Bahrgav Salvi and others for an outstanding amount of 27,32,438 rupees. Pushkar Niketan Co-operative Housing Society Ltd invited claims regarding the shares of deceased member Smt Anjali Ulhas Vaidya. A public notice was issued for the purchase of property in Chipale, Panvel, by a client of Adv Shailesh Manohar Panchal.

EBGNG.attchmntText: GNG Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
EBGNG.voiceSummary: GNG Electronics Limited filed a transcript of its earnings call with analysts and investors for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call was held on November 03, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR624.8 crores for the quarter, up from INR439.9 crores in the same period last year. Gross margin improved by 515 basis points year-on-year to 25.1%. For the first half of FY27, revenue stood at INR1,037 crores, a 38% increase from the prior year. The company stated it is ahead of its full year FY27 guidance on both revenue growth and profitability. The filing was submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

UTLSOLAR.attchmntText: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
UTLSOLAR.voiceSummary: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited, trading as UTL Solar, filed a presentation for an Analysts and Investors meet scheduled for November 10, 2026. The company reported Q2 FY2027 revenue from operations of Rs. 13,068 Mn, up 130.1% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 2,229 Mn, an increase of 116.4% year-on-year. The EBITDA margin moderated to 17.1% from 18.1% in the previous year. The company commissioned a 2 GW power electronics manufacturing facility at Ratlam, bringing total power electronics capacity to 4.1 GW. A 1.2 GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility at Ratlam is expected to be commissioned by Q1 FY2028. The company added more than 30 distributors and 100 dealers, taking the total channel partner base to over 10,200 as of September 30, 2026.

CMRGREEN.attchmntText: CMR Green Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
CMRGREEN.voiceSummary: CMR Green Technologies Limited filed an investor presentation regarding financial results for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2026-27 ended on 30th September 2026. The company reported revenue of Rs. 3,471.9 crore for Q2 FY27, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 59.2%. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 72.6 crore, up 25.4% year-on-year. EBITDA reached Rs. 150.7 crore, showing a 30.5% increase. Sales volume grew 14.4% year-on-year to 1,19,959 metric tons. For the half-year, revenue was Rs. 6,594.6 crore, and PAT was Rs. 140.8 crore. The presentation is available on the company website at www.cmr.co.in.
